title: Korea is rebuilding its chip supply chain around proximity, not price
summary: SK hynix's 1.4 trillion won supplier programme and the 874.6 billion won Trinity Fab answer a bottleneck: Korean memory leadership still rests on roughly 30% domestic sourcing for materials and equipment, and a result proven on an 8-inch laboratory wafer does not qualify on a 12-inch line. Paying half of development costs up front and compensating suppliers whose projects fail is procurement run as industrial policy. The counterexample is China, where Meituan trained a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model on Huawei accelerators and published a self-hosting guide with no Nvidia configuration.
